about: Synthetic hirer sentences for the Cofferdam Work intent parse (S5) and recall (S6-S7): the canonical prompt set of docs/product/work-wallet.md (Hirer prompt set) in en-US, pt-BR and es-MX, a budget in another currency (no dollar amount may be read from it), and two prompts per language the plane must refuse. `region` is the coarse region the phone would send, never a position. In `expected`, strings are exact spans of the sentence; `budgetUsd` is null when the sentence names no dollar amount (a bare number is USDC, as in the chat, decision 0046); `scope` is onsite or remote; `refuse` names the check that must refuse it.

prompts.text: My kitchen sink is leaking under the cabinet, need someone today after 2pm. I'll pay $120.

expected.task: kitchen sink is leaking under the cabinet

prompts.text: Need a licensed electrician to install a 220V EV charger in my garage this Saturday, budget $400.

expected.task: install a 220V EV charger in my garage

prompts.text: Looking for a certified rigger to help move a 2-ton genset onto my boat at Galveston marina Friday morning, $300.

expected.task: move a 2-ton genset onto my boat
